name: vibe-coding-assistant
description: AI coding assistant with file editing tools

commands.title: OpenVibe: 迁移 API Key 到 SecretStorage

vibe-coding.apiKey.description: API Key (user-level only; recommended to use SecretStorage via the migrate command)

enumDescriptions: 根据 Base URL 主机名自动识别（推荐）
阿里云百炼 DashScope 兼容模式 —— enable_thinking
月之暗面 Kimi —— 不发送思考参数
本地服务（Ollama / vLLM / LM Studio） —— 不发送思考参数
通用 OpenAI 兼容 —— 只发送标准字段，兼容任何实现
vibe-coding.apiProvider.description: API 服务商预设。决定请求体中的思考/推理参数使用哪种写法（各厂商不通用，发错字段会返回 400）。auto 时按 vibe-coding.apiBaseUrl 的主机名自动识别。单个模型可在 vibe-coding.models 里用 provider 字段单独覆写。

enumDescriptions: 跟随当前服务商预设（推荐）
enable_thinking: true（硅基流动 / 阿里云百炼，Qwen3、GLM、DeepSeek-V3.1 混合思考模型）
不发送任何厂商专有思考参数（最兼容，未知字段一律不发）
vibe-coding.thinkingMode.description: 思考参数方言覆写。思考强度设为 off 时：thinking_type 方言发送 thinking.type=disabled，其余方言一律不发送思考参数（可用作兼容任何服务的兜底手段）。

vibe-coding.models.description: List of model configurations for model switching. Each entry can override apiBaseUrl, apiKey, provider, thinkingMode, maxInteractions, and maxSequenceLength. Falls back to global vibe-coding.* settings when omitted.

name.description: Display name shown in the model selector dropdown

model.description: Model name to send to the API (e.g. gpt-4o, deepseek-chat)

apiBaseUrl.description: Optional base URL override for this model (falls back to vibe-coding.apiBaseUrl)

apiKey.description: Optional API key override for this model (falls back to vibe-coding.apiKey)

provider.description: Optional API vendor preset for this model (falls back to vibe-coding.apiProvider). Lets one model list mix vendors, e.g. DeepSeek + 硅基流动.

thinkingMode.description: Optional reasoning-parameter dialect for this model (falls back to the provider preset). 'none' never sends vendor-specific reasoning fields.

maxInteractions.description: Optional max tool call iterations override for this model (-1 = unlimited, falls back to vibe-coding.maxInteractions)

maxSequenceLength.description: Optional max context/sequence length override for this model in characters (falls back to vibe-coding.maxSequenceLength)

contextWindow.description: 该模型的上下文窗口（token，0/留空 = 回退全局 vibe-coding.contextWindow）。决定压缩阈值与自动压缩时机。

maxOutputTokens.description: 该模型的单次回复上限（token，0/留空 = 回退全局 vibe-coding.maxOutputTokens）。作为 max_tokens 下发。

thinkingBudget.description: 该模型的思维链预算（token，0/留空 = 回退全局 vibe-coding.thinkingBudget）。仅 enable_thinking 方言下发。

vibe-coding.toolProfile.description: Name of the active tool profile. Profiles are JSON files in the global tool-profiles directory that list tools to hide from the LLM. 'full' (default) hides nothing. Changing this setting applies immediately.

vibe-coding.confirmChanges.description: Whether to ask for confirmation before applying file changes (edit tool)

vibe-coding.confirmShellCommand.description: Whether to ask for confirmation before executing run_shell_command (after shell review); independent from confirmChanges

vibe-coding.maxInteractions.description: Maximum number of tool call iterations (-1 means unlimited)

vibe-coding.maxSequenceLength.description: Maximum length for generated text sequences

vibe-coding.contextWindow.description: 模型上下文窗口（token）。0 = 不启用精确控制（沿用内置 1M 压缩阈值）。设为该模型真实窗口（如 Qwen3 131072、32K 模型 32768）后：压缩阈值 = 窗口 − 输出预留 − 思维链预留，且上游报「上下文超限」时会自动压缩并重试一次。可在模型列表中按模型覆写。

vibe-coding.maxOutputTokens.description: 单次回复输出上限（token），作为请求体 max_tokens 下发。0 = 不发送（交给服务端默认）。硅基流动官方建议不要把 max_tokens 顶到窗口上限，需为输入预留约 10k。

vibe-coding.thinkingBudget.description: 思维链（CoT）预算，仅 enable_thinking 方言（硅基流动 / 阿里云百炼）下发 thinking_budget，平台取值 128–32768。0 = 不发送。

enumDescriptions: Auto-detect based on user's VS Code display language (English if UI is English, Chinese if UI is Chinese)
vibe-coding.language.description: Language for AI assistant interaction. Controls the language used in system prompts, tool descriptions, and assistant responses.

vibe-coding.reasoningEffort.description: DeepSeek 思考模式强度（reasoning_effort）。off 表示关闭思考；其余档位会在请求中携带 thinking.type=enabled 与对应的 reasoning_effort。

vibe-coding.todolistReview.enabled.description: When true, create_todo_list runs a blocking independent LLM review for todolist.generate / todolist.edit before applying changes.

vibe-coding.todolistReview.maxAttempts.description: Max review/regenerate rounds per create_todo_list call (generate or expand).

vibe-coding.todolistReview.reviewTimeout.description: HTTP timeout (ms) for each review-agent and regenerate (generate) API call.

vibe-coding.todolistReview.editorTimeout.description: HTTP timeout (ms) for each editor-agent API call (todolist.edit expand retries).

vibe-coding.memorySync.enabled.description: When true, the harness tracks memory synchronization: after each sub-agent (executor) completes, it detects files modified but not yet registered in .OpenVibe/memory/L2-inventory.md and instructs the review agent to sync them (contact = record). Set to false to disable automatic memory tracking.

vibe-coding.editReview.enabled.description: When true, code edit tool calls run a blocking independent LLM review (separate from the main assistant) before applying changes.

vibe-coding.editReview.timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout (ms) for the independent review call used by the code edit tool.

vibe-coding.shellCommandReview.enabled.description: When true, run_shell_command runs an independent safety review before optional human confirmation (single-pass, same mode as code edit review).

vibe-coding.shellCommandReview.reviewTim.description: HTTP timeout (ms) for the shell safety review API call.

scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('fs').mkdirSync('out')"
